name: Hechtsee
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hechtsee near Kufstein is a scenic alpine woodland swimming lake up to 57 m deep, nestled beneath the Thierberg ridge with a circular promenade and mountain vistas.
preis: Lakeshore loop freely accessible; Hechtsee beach lido charges admission during summer
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeside path open year-round; swimming facilities operate May through September
beschreibung:
Überblick

The enchanting Lake Hechtsee lies at an elevation of 542 metres in a sheltered forest basin just north of the historic fortress city of Kufstein, nestled beneath the verdant slopes of the Thierberg ridge. Covering roughly 28 hectares and plunging to an impressive depth of 57 metres, Hechtsee is the largest and deepest water body among the celebrated Kufstein lake district. Replenished continuously by subterranean springs, the lake boasts exceptional water purity and a distinctive emerald-green hue. In the calm surface, the craggy limestone towers of the Kaiser Mountains (Kaisergebirge) and dense mixed woodlands reflect gracefully, offering an idyllic escape for swimmers, walkers, and photography enthusiasts throughout the seasons. During warm summer months, the landscaped lido featuring manicured sunbathing lawns, floating swim piers, and beach volleyball courts draws happy families, while the circular nature trail invites leisurely exploration year-round.

Route & Anforderungen

Circling Lake Hechtsee is a cherished excursion suitable for all generations. The broad, crushed-gravel shoreline trail spans 2.6 kilometres and is completed in roughly 45 to 60 minutes of effortless walking. Without significant inclines, the level promenade is entirely barrier-free and optimally suited for strollers and senior walkers. Well-placed wooden benches and lakeside viewing decks provide frequent opportunities to pause and admire resting waterfowl. Energetic hikers can expand the loop into the rewarding 'Four Lakes Hike', linking Hechtsee with adjacent forest tarns including Egelsee, Längsee, and Pfrillsee (approx. 2.5 hours walking time). Casual walking sneakers suffice for the lake perimeter, whereas supportive shoes with treaded soles are recommended for extended woodland hillside paths.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via motorway A12 (exit Kufstein Nord), following the dedicated Hechtseestraße directly to the lake basin. Spacious parking areas are located right beside the beach entrance (parking fees apply during peak summer season). Rail travelers arrive at Kufstein international station, where dedicated municipal shuttle buses operate during the summer swimming season, whisking bathers straight to the lakeshore.

Tipps

Conclude your stroll on the panoramic waterside terrace of the 'Seearena Hechtsee' restaurant. Savoring locally caught fresh trout or warm Tyrolean apple strudel while taking in the calm reflections of the Zahmer Kaiser peaks across the water is an absolute delight.
